signals.summary: Copper extended losses toward $4.20/lb as US inflation policy fueled rate expectations & smelter bottlenecks in South America.
signals.impact_guidance: High probability of spread compression on cathode physical premiums.

signals.summary: Aluminum slid to $2,450/t as dollar firmed and EGA restarted smelter capacity at Al Taweelah while European demand softened.
signals.impact_guidance: Slight inventory buildup across European warehouses; hedging recommended for Q4 exposure.

signals.summary: Zinc SHG Rotterdam premium surged to $330/t with spot concentrate TC at record low -$115/t in latest market scan.
signals.impact_guidance: Smelter margin compression forcing production cuts across European refineries.

signals.summary: Chinese lithium carbonate slumped 3.5% to CNY 104,400/t following spot market supply adjustments and EV battery destocking.
signals.impact_guidance: Cathode producers deferring long-term contract pricing negotiations to Q1.

signals.summary: Indonesian NPI output expands as LME class 1 stocks rise to 18-month highs; stainless steel scrap discounts widening.
signals.impact_guidance: Physical premiums in Asian hubs holding flat at $150/MT.

signals.summary: DRC export quota discussions and Durban port congestion lead to prompt delivery tightness in European warehouse stocks.
signals.impact_guidance: Aerospace alloy demand remains resilient despite battery sector shift.

signals.summary: Qingdao port inventories tick higher to 142M MT as Chinese steel mills cap crude steel production ahead of winter emission controls.
signals.impact_guidance: Freight rates on West Australia to Qingdao route holding at $9.20/MT.

signals.summary: Dryness in Southern Plains and Black Sea export corridor tensions send milling wheat futures up +4.2% on Chicago board.
signals.impact_guidance: Millers extending coverage ratios from 45 days to 90 days.

signals.summary: US Midwest harvest progress reaches 68% complete; yield reports slightly above early August USDA estimates.
signals.impact_guidance: River barge freight rates along Mississippi stabilizing post-dredging.

signals.summary: Early winter heating demand forecasts and Gulf Coast LNG export facility feedgas demand rising toward 14.5 Bcf/d.
signals.impact_guidance: Storage injection rates slowing; storage surplus narrowing vs 5-year average.

signals.summary: Crude trades near $78.50/bbl as non-OPEC supply growth balances voluntary OPEC+ supply cuts through end of year.
signals.impact_guidance: Refinery utilization rates at 91.2% in US Gulf Coast.

signals.summary: US Gulf cracker restarts increase monomer availability; European derivative export margins remain squeezed by energy costs.
signals.impact_guidance: Polymer converters maintaining lean inventory posture.
